title: Exploding Clay
body:
Syntax: exploding clay <target>

Description: Attaches a consumed Wad of Exploding Clay. After two combat pulses it detonates for 45-70 damage unless disabled. Requires a carried exploding clay. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 50. Costs 50 Chakra and 20 Stamina; 9 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
